acStaffForgot: Forgot it? Ask the shop owner to reset it.
acStaffNote: You signed in with the password the shop gave you. To add an email or Google, or to open a shop of your own, sign in with your own phone.

act.addon_ending_warned: Warned that an add-on ends soon
act.addon_not_renewed: An add-on did not renew: the balance was too short
act.catalog_feed_regenerated: {{actor}} made a new catalog feed link
act.downgrade_final_warning_sent: The last warning about being over the limits was sent
act.order_call_logged: {{actor}} logged a call to a customer
act.pack_auto_buy_failed: Auto-buy couldn’t buy a pack: the balance was too short
act.plan_assigned: The shop was put on a plan
act.plan_limit_override_removed: Lytro support removed a limit it had set
act.plan_limit_override_set: Lytro support set a limit for the shop

act.retention_shortened_notice_sent: The notice of a shorter activity history was sent

actEmpty: No activity yet. Sign-ins, changes and payments will show here.
actFilterEmpty: Nothing of this kind in this period.
adCapiHelp: Purchase is also sent from the server with the same event ID; the token is hidden once entered and never shown again.
adLog: Connecting, changing and removing are in the activity log.
adPixelHelp: Landing pages and the storefront send PageView, ViewContent, InitiateCheckout and Purchase.
akCreatedLead: Shown this one time only. If it is lost, make a new key and revoke this one.
akEmpty: No API keys yet. Make the first for your own website or app.
akLead: The keys your own website or app uses to read the catalogue and place orders at api.lytro.app/v1. Up to 20 live.
akRevokeCons: It stops working at once; a site using it breaks. Put the new key in first; two can run together.
akRotate: To rotate: make a new key, deploy it, then revoke the old one.
akSitesHelp: Exact origins, https; up to 10. From a browser the key works only from these.
akValueNever: The key value is never shown again; make a new key if you need one.
bfHeadOnlyNote: Galada with Playfair Display is for headings only: lovely large, hard to read in long text.
bfHint: Each choice pairs a Bangla font with an English one. Bangla text shows in the first and English in the second, by itself.
bizNote: Sets defaults for new products. Existing products do not change.
brApplied: Your brand is on · it shows everywhere within a minute
brBuyToOn: Buy the add-on to switch on
brContrast: Text colours are worked out for you. Your brand switches on only when every pair is easy to read.
brDarkHint: Shown in dark places, such as your storefront’s footer. A white or light logo on a transparent background works best.
brFailBanner: Some colours are hard to read together. Your brand cannot switch on until every pair passes.
brIconBad: The icon must be square, at least 512 × 512 px. This one is {{width}} × {{height}}.
brIconHint: The icon of your installed app and browser tab. Square, at least 512 × 512 px.
brLapsed: The brand add-on has ended, so your storefront shows the Lytro default. Your settings are kept and come back when you buy it again.
brLeave: Your changes to the brand identity are not saved yet. If you leave now, they are lost.
brLightNote: On light, your shop logo shows; change it in Shop details.
brNever: Never changes: page layouts, the status colours (paid, pending, failed), "Powered by Lytro" and "Secured by Lytro".
brNoAddon: Switching your brand on needs the brand identity add-on ({{price}}/month). You can design and save it now.
brNoAddonPlain: Switching your brand on needs the brand identity add-on. You can design and save it now.
brOff: Your brand is off · everyone sees the Lytro default
brPvNote: The preview changes at once; your live storefront changes when you apply or save.
brSavedLapsed: Saved · this shows again when you buy the add-on
brSavedOff: Saved · your brand stays off until you switch it on
brSavedOn: Saved · your changes show within a minute
brSavedTrial: Saved · you can switch it on once you have the add-on
brTrialNote: On the trial you can design, preview and save your brand. Switching it on needs the brand add-on ({{price}}/month), and buying it needs a plan.
brTrialNotePlain: On the trial you can design, preview and save your brand. Switching it on needs the brand add-on, and buying it needs a plan.
brUseOff: Off · everyone sees the Lytro default
brUseOn: On across the storefront, landing pages and dashboard · add-on until {{date}}
brUseOnPlan: On across the storefront, landing pages and dashboard · included in your plan
contactNote: Shown in the storefront footer. Empty ones are left out.
exEmpty: No exports yet. A new one is ready in a few minutes.
exLead: Invoices, activity, products and stock as CSV and JSON. Takes a few minutes; the link lasts 24 hours.
fdLead: Give this link to Commerce Manager and your products appear in the Facebook and Instagram shop, one row per variant.
fdRegenCons: The old link stops working at once; Commerce Manager needs the new one.
fdS1: Catalog, Data sources, Add items, Data feed
fdS2: Choose "Use a URL", paste the link, keep "Hourly"
fdS3: Currency BDT; the variant ids are the Pixel's content_ids
fdS4: After the first sync, check the variants in the shop
firstPwNote: Read this out. It must be changed at first sign-in.
idEmailLead: You can sign in with this email too, and a reset code can go here if you forget the password.
idLastCons: Add a phone, an email or Google first, then you can remove this one.
idLastTitle: This is the only way to sign in
idRemoveCons: You will no longer sign in with {{provider}}. The phone and the other ways stay; nothing in the shop changes.
inIosSteps: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. The icon stays as it is now; a later logo change won’t update it.
inSub: An icon on the home screen, opens full screen, with your logo
logoBadType: Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
logoFailed: The image could not be used. Try another one.
logoNote: Without a logo the first letter shows.
nobodyDeleted: Deactivating keeps the history and frees the seat. Nobody is deleted.
pmPaymentsManage: Pay for the plan, add-ons and packs
pmSettings: Change shop settings, delivery and brand
pwForgotLink: Forgot the current one? Send a code to the phone
pwMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
pwOthersOut: Changing it signs out every other device; this one stays.
recoveryNote: If you forget the password, a code goes to this phone.
roleDelLead: The role goes. Nobody holds it, so nobody’s work changes.
roleDelUsed_one: {{count}} person holds this role. Give them another role first, then it can be deleted.
roleDelUsed_other: {{count}} people hold this role. Give them another role first, then it can be deleted.
roleNone: No roles yet. Make the first from what staff may do.
roleNoneSheet: No roles yet. Create one to give this person.
sApiD: For your own website or app
seatsFull: All seats are full. Deactivate someone, or see plans for more.
seatsUnlimited: {{used}} seats in use, owner included; no limit
shopLinkNote: Set once; renaming the shop never changes it.
stAddFullLead: All {{total}} seats are in use, the owner’s included.
stAddWaysBoth: To add someone, deactivate someone, buy a seat ({{price}}/month), or move to {{plan}}.
stAddWaysNone: To add someone, deactivate someone first.
stAddWaysPlan: To add someone, deactivate someone or move to {{plan}}.
stAddWaysSeat: To add someone, deactivate someone or buy a seat ({{price}}/month).
stDeactCons: They are signed out at once and cannot sign in. The seat frees up; their history stays. You can reactivate later.
stPhoneFixed: The phone number cannot change; a new number is a new staff member.
stPwLead: A new first password is made for {{name}}. It shows once.
stPwNote: Read it out or send it. It must be changed at first sign-in; their old sessions end.
stReactFullLead: Reactivating {{name}} needs a seat: {{used}} of {{total}} are in use.
stReactivateSub: They can sign in again; it takes a seat.
stWaysBoth: Deactivate someone, buy a seat ({{price}}/month), or move to {{plan}}.
stWaysNoPay: Deactivate someone to free a seat; the owner can buy a seat or change the plan.
stWaysSeat: Deactivate someone or buy a seat ({{price}}/month).
sStoreD: Your shop's link, and switching it on or off
sfLinkHint: Customers see all your products at this link. Each product also has its own landing page, for ads.
sfSwitchOn: Anyone with the link sees your shop.
sfSwitchOff: Off: the link shows "Nothing here". Product landing pages keep working.
sfOffNote: Have your own website? You can keep it off. Your products, orders and customers all stay.
sfOffCons: Opening {{address}} shows "Nothing here" at once. Product landing pages keep working. You can turn it on again any time.
akStorefrontNote: The first key is the one Lytro keeps for your storefront. It is not one of your 20 and cannot be changed or revoked; its requests count with the rest.
